scale.0: Wrong, missing, or an unsupported success claim.
scale.1: Mostly right, but missing a relevant boundary or asks for avoidable work.
scale.2: Correct, evidence-linked, and sufficient for this question.

dimensions.next_action: Uses a supported next action; permits ending or further rounds as warranted.
dimensions.evidence_retrieval: Finds the relevant owned records without broad rereading or copied facts.
dimensions.unsupported_claims: Separates measured facts, predictions, interpretation, and unverified scope.
dimensions.recovery: Preserves valid takes and incumbent; names needed re-establishment and honest failures.
dimensions.human_effort: One grant for ordinary trials at a held pose; new pose/recovery is explicit.
dimensions.resource_use: Uses relevant bounded reads/analysis; no needless sound or ceremonial rounds. Compare actual tokens and time separately.

sufficient_current_round: May finish after this round; explicitly adopt the named measured candidate if selected.
State coverage and listening limits; do not demand a final-confirmation round or claim new acoustics.
reuse_after_restore: Round 5 or later remains available; restore does not end iteration.
Build C from referenced role/filter parts with its own identity and unmeasured status.
Keep expected effect separate; parent co-variation does not establish isolated causality.
alignment_sum: Inspect phase composition and actual trims; solo magnitudes cannot decide summed alignment.
Use banked complex sum as prediction and a relevant protected summed trial as measurement.
candidate_trim: Play and record each candidate's complete filters and own trim.
Inspect level frame and trim source; a carried pin is not newly measured.
declared_protection: Do not play below declared protection on the strength of a prediction.
Use a supported safe design/candidate; this failed input is not a permanent experiment ban.
household_layers: Baseline is the base; every solo/summed/cloud/angle capture excludes previous correction and higher layers as applicable.
Enforce scope in composition, retain household settings, and restore normal playback after temporary activity.
stale_packet: Inspect/enrich first, then freeze a new packet and bind a new prescription to it.
Use that same packet for propose and stage; expose the prior snapshot as stale without rewriting history.
banked_history: Read live and campaign-bank sources through the existing record boundary.
Use identity/compatibility context and artifact references; banked records remain evidence after session eviction.
pose_batch_retake: Continue ordinary configs under one grant and tell the human to keep the mic still.
After a bump, require deliberate placement/recovery or retake; preserve earlier valid takes and disclose the interruption.
Reject stale position actions; do not join incompatible captures.
playback_failure: Record a failed take, not successful measurement; retain the older valid take.
Inspect/recover graph and volume state before more sound; do not assert restoration without proof.
After the condition is fixed, another bounded attempt is allowed.
number_overlap: Overlap does not verify fields, units, meaning, or a claim. Correct the swapped-unit claim.
Simulation is disclosure; a valid protected proposal can remain offered with explicit user confirmation.
